call_title: Paxel.ai - Product Feedback - Sara Workman (Kessen Pharma)

insights.quote: Did it not do that before... Oh, that's really valuable information to have there
insights.summary: Rep confirms value in carrying forward decline detail (quarterly/monthly/annual decline context) into the active opportunity list, which previously was lost.

insights.quote: Is this functionality going to be available on the account pages themselves in terms... that activities all of that will be available there
insights.summary: Rep wants an activity feed available at the account level, not just opportunity/contact level.

insights.quote: Because something similar to that is perhaps maybe in my feedback.
insights.summary: Rep signals interest in general account-level activity feed as a future feedback item.

insights.quote: I was very upset when you guys changed it to that recent thing the other day. I was like, "What the hell is happening? Why is nothing coming up? It took me forever to figure it out."
insights.summary: A recent change to the wayfinding page default view caused confusion and disrupted the rep's workflow until reverted.

insights.quote: The biggest struggle that I have on the accounts page is that it defaults to searching by owner.
insights.summary: Account search defaults to 'owner' filter, causing reps who need cross-territory visibility (e.g., covering for colleagues) to miss results and think accounts don't exist.

insights.quote: So if there were a way to save that like on a on an individual user level instead of messing with everyone.
insights.summary: Rep wants the account search filter default (owner vs. all) to be a persistent, per-user setting rather than a global default, since needs vary by role.

insights.quote: so that's mostly because my role here is changing. So I'm I'm having not only my accounts but I'm doing some um of bills as well from like a customer support standpoint.
insights.summary: Rep's expanding role (covering colleague's accounts for support) requires searching across all accounts, not just owned accounts, highlighting a cross-territory workflow gap.

insights.quote: I think that would actually be really nice. Yes.
insights.summary: Rep wants ability to share notes with or tag other reps/colleagues on shared accounts (e.g., overlapping IDN coverage).

insights.quote: Oh, that would be amazing, too. Um just because we are by like we are by state.
insights.summary: Rep wants a map view to filter/browse accounts by state/time zone to help structure daily call scheduling by time zone.

insights.quote: if I could make this one my homepage instead of that dashboard just because I this is the one I go to all the time, I would.
insights.summary: Rep wants the ability to set the wayfinding/account page as their default homepage instead of the dashboard.

insights.quote: I'm trying to look at some of the sales data differently than they currently do, and this will be so helpful.
insights.summary: Contract performance dashboard (top products/accounts driving performance) provides a new, valued way to analyze sales data beyond current company reporting.

insights.quote: I could spend hours looking at this stuff.
insights.summary: Rep finds the contract performance drill-down (sorting by trend vs. prior, products/accounts) highly engaging and useful for identifying win-back opportunities.

insights.quote: Can you guys help me understand pull through?
insights.summary: Rep needed clarification on what 'pull through' and the color-coding (green/yellow/red) mean on the contract pricing table, suggesting a need for in-product explanation/tooltips.

insights.quote: I also don't know much about cost... I can't get over like the difference in price though per contract. It still blows my mind.
insights.summary: New reps need better contextual education on pricing/contract mechanics (WAC, GPO, dish pricing) directly within the product to interpret large price variances.

insights.quote: If there's an um a use for this on that trade team, we'd love to actually chat with those individuals.
insights.summary: Contract performance and pricing features may have strong value for the customer's internal trade/pricing team (Chuck/Charles and Alexa), suggesting expansion beyond sales reps.

insights.quote: the fact that I I don't have an option to put a note there is not great for my brain. um because it just doesn't retain. So like I'll put a followup and then I don't really remember why I'm following up.
insights.summary: Rep wants richer, more detailed note/task fields attached to follow-ups (similar to HubSpot/Salesforce tasks) so she can recall context and reasons for follow-up later.

insights.quote: I guess I just have an expectation of finding um something a little more detailed... Yes.
insights.summary: Rep's workflow (touching ~40 accounts/day, tracking via external Excel) shows the need for an integrated task/note system with detailed context, replicating what she does in HubSpot/Salesforce today.

insights.quote: anytime I I document an Excel I copy paste it here. So like this would be my Excel note and that would be my email.
insights.summary: Rep manually maintains an external Excel spreadsheet as her primary task/note system and copy-pastes into Pulse, indicating the current in-app note/follow-up system is insufficiently detailed for her workflow.

insights.quote: we sometimes will not open um more than one Excel spreadsheet at a time. I don't know why. There's no real rhyme or reason to it.
insights.summary: Rep experiences unexplained technical issues opening multiple Excel spreadsheets simultaneously (possibly a local machine/performance issue, not necessarily Paxel-related, but affects her workflow around the product).

insights.quote: not everyone is utilizing Paxel across um Kessen as I understand it. So there's still I do a lot of documenting. Um sometimes it's triplicate.
insights.summary: Incomplete adoption of Paxel across the organization forces reps to document activity redundantly across multiple systems (Paxel, HubSpot, Excel).

key_themes: Follow-up/task notes need more depth and context to match reps' mental workflow (vs. HubSpot/Salesforce experience)
Search and filtering defaults (owner vs. all accounts) need to be user-configurable to support evolving/cross-territory roles
Contract performance dashboard and pricing visualizations are highly valued and seen as a differentiator, especially for understanding pull-through and price erosion
Decliner opportunity workflow improvements (context carry-forward) are well-received and increase usability
Users want persistent, personalized UI behavior (bookmarks, filter memory) rather than global defaults that serve the majority
suggested_next_steps: Sara Workman to send Paxel team her working document/list of product feedback issues before the next call
Schedule follow-up call next week (same time) to deep dive into Sara's full feedback list
Paxel team to reach out to Kessen Pharma's trade/pricing team members (Chuck/Charles and Alexa) to discuss contract performance and pricing features
Adjust default account search filter behavior (owner vs. all) for Sara Workman's use case
Explore making account-level activity feed a future product enhancement
Include Vince in follow-up meeting invite per Sara's request
